title: FDA clears AI tool that creates 3D bone visualizations from standard MRIs
key_facts: The FDA issued a 510(k) clearance for NextMR, an AI-enabled platform that makes 3D bone images from conventional 1.5T and 3T spine MRI.
Developer MRI2CT says it produces 3D bone views in under 60 seconds and shows axial, sagittal and coronal planes plus a 3D reconstruction.
It is a cloud-based application with no local software installation.
Surgeon Frank Phillips (Midwest Orthopaedics at Rush, Chicago) says it lets surgeons use the MRI a patient already has, which could mean avoiding extra imaging, radiation and appointments.
Clearance reported 7 Oct 2026 (Diagnostic Imaging and a Business Wire release).
quote_evidence: The cloud-based NextMR platform reportedly provides automated 3D bone images of conventional spine MRI images in less than 60 seconds.
For patients, that can mean avoiding additional imaging, radiation and appointments while helping streamline their path to surgery.”
why_it_matters_hint: Could let surgeons plan from the MRI already taken.
